subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, given the new authenticated microphone-audio RPC and provider privacy boundary?
rationale: Code review can identify the safer Gateway-backed shape versus browser Web Speech, but accepting a browser-to-Gateway audio transcription method and its provider/error behavior is a product and security-boundary choice.

options.title: Continue after proof and fixes
options.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the accessibility/docs/error-sanitization defects, and provide successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the feature issue
options.body: Keep the paired feature issue and this PR open while maintainers decide the Control UI dictation boundary and ownership.

options.title: Supersede with a fresh branch
options.body: Close or replace this stale branch if maintainers prefer a current-main implementation of the same Gateway-backed design.

recommendation.title: Continue after proof and fixes
recommendation.body: Require the branch or replacement to port onto current main, fix the accessibility/docs/error-sanitization defects, and provide successful redacted real behavior proof before merge.
